name: Compass Sensor
description: The sensor has a display to visualise the direction of north. The measured output is taken relative to the white arrow on the face of the display.
shortDescription: A digital compass that outputs a number value representing the turn that must be made for it to face north.

logicNodes.label: Backlight
logicNodes.description: Enables the backlight when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Compass Reading
logicNodes.description: The angle measured in turns that the needle is rotated from the white arrow on the display.
